name: wows-yolo-tourney-discord-bot
description: Hardened WoWS OCR battle reporter and 50-player YOLO Tourney bot with transactional local SQLite, public interactive controls, expanded workbook totals, and JSON/Discord recovery.

scripts.acceptance: npm test && npm run test:reported-screenshot && npm run test:four-images && npm run test:additional-images
scripts.test:multi-provider: node --test tests/azure-document-intelligence.test.js tests/azure-field-evidence.test.js tests/parallel-local-ocr.test.js tests/block-network.test.js tests/ocr-conflict-acceptance.test.js tests/ocr-accuracy-metrics.test.js
scripts.test:ocrspace: node --test tests/ocrspace.test.js tests/ocrspace-prepass.test.js tests/ocrspace-pdf-first.test.js tests/ocrspace-pdf-text-layer.test.js tests/ocrspace-reconciliation.test.js tests/ocr-report-metadata.test.js tests/parallel-ocr-readers.test.js
scripts.test:ocr: npm run test:multi-provider && npm run test:ocrspace && npm run test:ocr-sequence-checkpoint && npm run test:ocr-watchdog && npm run test:paddleocr-fallback
scripts.test:desktop: node --test tests/desktop-service.test.js tests/desktop-bridge.test.js tests/desktop-account-links.test.js tests/desktop-test-preflight.test.js tests/desktop-ui-contract.test.js
scripts.test:prelive: npm run test:discord-preflight && npm run preflight:desktop-test && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:ocr
